_note: Print settings from each manufacturer's own website/product pages. Provenance: Polar Filament densities taken from the manufacturer's own TDS PDFs (linked off polarfilament.com/pages/resources); Polar print/bed temps taken from the individual Polar product listings (the TDS explicitly defers to the product listing for current/validated print settings). 3D-Fuel Pro PETG nozzle temp from 3dfuel.com product pages. MatterHackers MH Build Series PLA from its own TDS (suggested print/bed temp + density). IC3D ABS and UV-Stable PETG density + drying from IC3D's own TDS PDFs (their TDS list injection-molding melt/mold temps, NOT FDM nozzle/bed, so nozzle/bed left null; the 250-260C / 105C bed figures circulating are from customer reviews and were NOT used). Addnorth E-PLA and PETG from addnorth.com knowledge-base print guides. Zortrax Z-PLA Pro density from its own TDS; Zortrax publishes no nozzle/bed temp for Z-PLA Pro (Z-SUITE auto profiles), and the TDS's 190C is the ISO 1133 MFR test temperature, not a recommended nozzle temp, so temps left null. Verified 2026-05-28.

records._source_note: Print/bed temp (215C +/-10C nozzle, 60C +/-5C bed) from Polar product listing https://polarfilament.com/products/polar-white-pla-1kg-2-85mm ; density 1.24 g/cc from Polar PLA TDS https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0529/9965/1523/files/Polar_Filament_PLA_TDS_Rev1.1.pdf

Print/bed temp (225C +/-10C nozzle, 60C +/-5C bed) from Polar PETG product listings (e.g. https://polarfilament.com/products/classic-black-petg-1kg-1-75mm , https://polarfilament.com/collections/petg ); density 1.27 from Polar PETG Engineering Grade TDS https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0529/9965/1523/files/Polar_Filament_PETG_Engineering_Grade_TDS_Rev1.0.pdf

Density 1.16 g/cm3 (ASTM D792) from Polar FR-ABS TDS https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0529/9965/1523/files/Polar_Filament_FR_ABS_TDS_Rev1.0.pdf ; no Polar FR-ABS product listing currently published, so no validated print/bed temps available (TDS defers print settings to the product listing).

Print/bed temp (230C +/-10C nozzle, 80C +/-5C bed) from Polar PA12 product listing https://polarfilament.com/products/natural-nylon-pa12-1kg-1-75mm ; density 0.95 g/cm3 from Polar PA12 (Nylon 12) Post-Industrial Recycled TDS https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0529/9965/1523/files/Polar_Filament_PA12_Post_Industrial_Recycled_TDS_Rev1.0.pdf

Hotend 220-230C, bed 60C from Polar TPU-60D product listing https://polarfilament.com/products/classic-black-flexible-tpu-60d-1kg-1-75mm ; specific gravity 1.25 from Polar HARD TPU-60D TDS https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0529/9965/1523/files/Polar_Filament_HARD_TPU_60D_TDS_Rev1.0.pdf

Nozzle 245-265C from 3D-Fuel Pro PETG product pages (e.g. https://www.3dfuel.com/products/workday-petg-filament-brightest-white-1-75mm ). 3D-Fuel does not publish a specific bed temp for Pro PETG on these pages (the 75-80C figures pertain to their separate Pro PCTG material and were not used).

Suggested Print Temperature 190-220C, Suggested Bed Temperature 60C, Density 1.25 g/cm3 (ISO 1183) from MatterHackers MH Build Series PLA Technical Data Sheet (linked from https://www.matterhackers.com/store/c/mh-build-series-pla , Last Updated 03/20/2024).

Density 1.03 g/cm3 (ASTM D792) and Drying Temperature 176-185F (80-85C) / Drying Time 2.0-4.0 hr from IC3D Standard ABS TDS https://www.ic3dprinters.com/ic3d/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/ABS-IC3D-TDS-2020.07.pdf . dry_temp recorded as lower bound 80C, dry_time as lower bound 2.0h. The TDS lists injection-molding barrel temps (374-446F) and mold temp, not FDM nozzle/bed, so nozzle/bed left null.

Density 1.27 g/cm3 (ASTM D792 / ISO 1183) and Drying Temperature 65C (150F) / Drying Time 4-6 hrs from IC3D Standard UV-PETG TDS https://www.ic3dprinters.com/ic3d/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/PETG-UV-IC3D-TDS-2021.05.pdf . dry_time recorded as lower bound 4.0h. TDS 'Processing Melt Temperature' 249-271C and 'Mold Temperature' are injection-molding values, not FDM nozzle/bed, so nozzle/bed left null.
Printing temperature 195-225C nozzle, 'no or up to 60C on the bed' from Addnorth E-PLA print guide https://addnorth.com/knowledge/articles/e-pla-print-guide

Printing temperature 225-260C nozzle, 'no or up to 80C on the bed', dry 5-6 hours at 65C from Addnorth PETG print guide https://addnorth.com/knowledge/articles/petg-print-guide . dry_time recorded as lower bound 5.0h.

Specific Density 1.426 g/cm3 (ISO 1183-3) from Zortrax Z-PLA Pro TDS https://zortrax.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/Z-PLA_Pro_Technical_Data_Sheet_eng_1.pdf . Zortrax publishes no recommended nozzle/bed temperature for Z-PLA Pro (Z-SUITE auto profiles); the TDS's 190C is the ISO 1133 melt-flow-rate test temperature, not a print setting, so temps left null.
